title: Cross-check real DGNL 2026 solution against the PDF: independent extraction + answers, defects, improvement list (REQ-0042)

design.summary: independent per-section solves from the PDF, extraction comparison, third-read adjudication, tier-0 recomputation; no paid run
risks: same-family solvers: agreement is not accuracy

implementation.summary: 4 independent section solves, 4 extraction checks, 2 adjudications, compare.py, Q66 recomputation, needs_review statistics (all under work/TASK-039, untracked)

unit_test.command: python3 -I work/TASK-039/compare.py; Q66 spanning tree; needs_review vs extraction statistics
unit_test.result: compare output matches the handoff tables; Q66 recomputed to 780 = option A; needs_review precision 2/6, recall of blocking 2/3 (no repo code changed, so the unit suite is unaffected)

security.result: analysis only; PDF is local input, question text kept out of the repo (work/ untracked, report cites printed numbers only)

verification.command: independent reads vs engine; extraction vs PDF; coordinator viewed PDF page 15 and recomputed Q66
verification.result: findings consistent across independent readers; the Q66 extraction defect confirmed by the coordinator from the page image and the extracted file

quality.reason: independent per-section reads and extraction comparison; coordinator recomputed Q66 and the needs_review statistics; limits stated (same model family)

coder.waiver: no code change: analysis task, comparison scripts live in work/TASK-039 (untracked)

verifier.waiver: work/TASK-039/handoff/ verifier role subagents did the independent reads and checks

crosscheck.waiver: the task itself is the cross-check; key findings recomputed by the coordinator (Q66, needs_review statistics)

checkpoint.next: 4 verifier subagents solving independently (work/TASK-039/handoff/indep-*.md); then run work/TASK-039/compare.py, adjudicate disagreements with a 2nd independent solve, extraction cross-check, improve
